Subject: Limited spots available—don’t miss out!

Hi [Name],

Act now—this offer expires this Friday! TaskHaven is the last project tool you will ever need. Don’t be left behind while your competitors get ahead. Spots are filling fast and we can only take 20 new customers this month.

Here’s what you’ll get:
• Automated reminders sent to task owners 24 hours before due dates
• Shared team boards to track progress in real time
• Tag-based filtering by project or priority so nothing slips through

But you have to act immediately. This founding price won’t last. Once those 20 slots are gone, they’re gone. Book your demo before it’s too late at https://example.org/taskhaven/demo.

Don’t wait—your competitors aren’t.

The TaskHaven Team
